notes.title: New Version (v2) OUT NOW
notes.notes:
We have enjoyed watching your Twitch and YouTube video's and have listening to your feedback.

We have therefore reduced the sensitivity of the mouse as requested by many people and also fixed the issue where you can drop out of the maze during the 2nd level due to a gap in the wall.

Please let us know should you find any other issues and we will get straight on the case.
